summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Allspring SMID Core ETF (ASCE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in extended market equity. The fund actively invests in large-cap companies in the US, selected through a combination of fundamental analysis and a proprietary valuation framework. ASCE was launched on Jul 7, 2025 and is issued by Allspring.

holdings.infoBox: ASCE is an equity ETF with a total of 53 individual holdings. The top holdings are Amneal Pharmaceuticals stock at 2.96%, Exelixis at 2.77%, Universal Health Services at 2.53%, Semtech at 2.51%, and Teekay Corporation at 2.48%.
